# Yegor Bugayenko

> Personal blog about computers, programming, object-oriented design, and software management, written by Yegor Bugayenko and published at https://www.yegor256.com.

A clean Markdown version of every post is served at the same URL with the `.html` extension replaced by `.md`, for example https://www.yegor256.com/2026/06/01/title.md. The Markdown sources of every HTML page also live in a public GitHub repository: https://github.com/yegor256/blog

## Details

- [Repository](https://github.com/yegor256/blog): Markdown sources of all pages
- [RSS feed](https://www.yegor256.com/rss.xml): full list of posts
- [Sitemap](https://www.yegor256.com/sitemap.xml): all URLs
